title: Soft-chemistry routes to entropy-engineered nanomaterials: complexity-driven performance in redox electrocatalysis
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE00987E, Review Article
Linwei Jiang, Cuifang Wang, Huaiyuan Kang, Zhiwen Lu, Hsien-Yi Hsu, Zongyou Yin, Mark A. Buntine, Zongping Shao, Zhenhai Wen, Guohua Jia
Soft-chemistry routes enable the tailored synthesis of entropy-engineered nanomaterials with tunable size, morphology, and unconventional phases, unlocking multielement synergy for efficient redox electrocatalysis.
